title: Shi Khung Ki Biria (Ballad of Village Wit and Festive Merriment)
cultural_context: Lighthearted folk ballad sung at market days (*Sngi Iew*) and harvest celebrations to lift community spirits with traditional wit (*ka biria*).

khasi: Samrkhie ko para, pynsalit ia ka jingsngewsih,
Da ka biria ba shongkun ki kpa barim,
Ha madan iew ngi ia kynduh lang,
Ban pynkmen ia ka mynsiem da ka sur ba thiang.
english: Laugh together, O kin, dispel all sorrow and gloom,
With the genial wit and humor of the ancient fathers,
Upon the village market square we meet as one,
To gladden the spirit with sweet melody.

vocabulary.biria-shongkun: refined, dignified, traditional humor and wit
